n1.speaker: npc_marrow
n1.text: You're the new Deferred. Desk, lamp, two stamps.

n2.speaker: npc_marrow
n2.text: Gold sends them up, red sends them down. Try not to confuse them; the appeals take a century.

n3.speaker: npc_marrow
n3.text: Your appointment was signed in advance by the Principal and the Counterparty. God and the Devil, if you like. They don't.

n4.speaker: npc_marrow
n4.text: Your docket: three souls. The Registrar in the Arrival Hall calls them for you, one at a time.

n5.speaker: npc_marrow
n5.text: Read the file. Every entry has a weight. Add them. Above nothing, Gilt Gate. Below nothing, Ember Gate.

n6.speaker: npc_marrow
n6.text: That is the Rubric, and for your first soul the Rubric will do.

n7.speaker: npc_marrow
n7.text: Bring the soul to your desk, the one by the bench. Sit, read, stamp. The soul will find its own door.
